title: Integration normalization of vector-bundle purity
statement: In the finite coefficient setting [def-pur-conventions], for a rank-d vector bundle pi:E→B of [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], write W=pi^* A_B(d)[2d], and let t:Rpi_!W→A_B be the actual trace [def-amb-vector-integration]. Define integration-normalized purity to mean that the actual projection map is invertible on D^b_ctf, there is a unique natural isomorphism alpha:Rpi^!≈(W tensor pi^*) on that category with Rpi_!(alpha_K^{-1}) followed by the counit equal to inverse projection followed by t tensor K and the unitor, and there is a unique beta:Rpi^!A_B≈W whose inverse has trace t. For an inverse-purity natural family gamma on the ambient ordinary-etale derived categories, its normalization is the same projection/counit equation on every component. This determines its components independently of any compatibility equation.
